fact: Zimbabwe has the foundations of an operational social registry, ZISO, managed by the Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare, and the first phase of data collection was completed in December 2025 in Mangwe district, covering 19,645 households; a grant approved 29 May 2026 finances enumeration of at least 160,000 more households.
title: Zimbabwe Social Registry Support Project (Project Paper, Report No: PPHI01473)
